identity_cost.detail: any-phone: registration takes a Telegram ID and nothing else. The form carries one field, 'Telegram ID:', marked required, filled from the provider's own bot ('Send private message to @HaxTG_bot, type this command:'), and the provider's walkthrough states 'To register on the Hax.co.id site, you need a Telegram ID.' The login page states 'Please login using your telegram account'. Phone: required, because Telegram states 'Please also note that Telegram accounts can only be connected to a mobile number.' Card: not published: https://hax.co.id/register (2026-11-06) carries no card field. Country: not published: the registration page states no country restriction.
